kvm_pool_capacity.sampling: 30-second steps, excluding the left endpoint. Fresh samples under 180 seconds. Complete when the count of workers reporting fit equals desired replicas. Missing queue series counted as zero.

query.busy: sum((max by(namespace,pod) ((buildbuddy_remote_execution_assigned_milli_cpu{namespace="buildbuddy-executor",service="buildbuddy-kvm-worker-metrics",endpoint="metrics",pod=~"virt-launcher-buildbuddy-kvm-worker-[0-9]+-.*"} and (time()-timestamp(buildbuddy_remote_execution_assigned_milli_cpu{namespace="buildbuddy-executor",service="buildbuddy-kvm-worker-metrics",endpoint="metrics",pod=~"virt-launcher-buildbuddy-kvm-worker-[0-9]+-.*"})<180))) > bool 0) and on(namespace,pod) (buildbuddy_kvm_worker:fits_vm_suite and (time()-timestamp(buildbuddy_kvm_worker:fits_vm_suite)<180)))

kvm_pool_capacity.limit: Local reservation counts can include multiple reservations of one task. Required-check delay and distinct queued tasks were not attributed.
